title: Add VPC control plane Terraform: multi-AZ subnets, interface endpoints, SGs, peering, Route53 delegation
author: Priya Kapoor
description: Add a first-class Terraform module and Helm upgrade/rollback hooks to provision the Private Control Plane VPC resources required for Private deployments. Motivation: make private-installer able to bootstrap multi-AZ control plane networking reliably (subnets, interface endpoints, security groups, cross-account peering, and Route53 private hosted zone delegation) and provide safe upgrade/rollback behavior in customer environments. This change includes: 1) new terraform module 'vpc-control-plane' that supports multi-AZ subnet creation (public/private patterns used by control plane), interface endpoints for S3/SSM/EC2 into the control plane VPC, security group templates with restrictive defaults and required tags, cross-account VPC peering resources and IAM/sts assume-role outputs for delegated peering, and Route53 private hosted zone delegation resources to support customer DNS and Route53 Resolver rules; 2) Helm chart changes in private-installer to add pre-install/post-install/rollback hooks which run terraform plan/apply via the installer bootstrap job and ensure deterministic teardown on failure; 3) integration tests and CI pipeline updates (terraform validate/plan and a new ephemeral-account apply job) plus documentation updates and examples in docs/private/vpc-setup.md. Checklist: [x] Terraform module with variables/outputs, [x] helm hooks and templates, [x] integration tests and sample fixture, [x] docs and upgrade notes, [x] security review performed. Related Linear: ENG-2891, ENG-2910. Impact: enables Private deployments for multi-AZ installs; no breaking API changes. See files_changed for details and the review conversation for required changes and approvals.
release_notes: Adds Terraform module and Helm hooks to provision multi-AZ subnets, interface endpoints, security groups, cross-account peering, and Route53 private hosted zone delegation for the private control plane. Includes upgrade and rollback hooks for private-installer and integration test coverage.

notes: This change is intended to be backward compatible but requires operator action for existing single-AZ control planes to adopt the new module.
Follow-up work: add cross-region peering support (ENG-3042) and improve resolver rule automation.
Backport considerations: none for hosted API; ops may want a patch for older private-installer branches (labelled backport-needed).
